request: 我写了一个方案，请针对 issue640 的提案进行整改：标准 aide 启动器流程规范
acceptance: Source and Release start never compile, including when legacy build environment variables are set; repeat healthy start opens existing workbench.
Source build is explicit and incremental, orchestrates runtime/host compilation and starts only the successfully built source image; failure never substitutes a Release.
Source clean clears build outputs/cache then builds; docker_clean removes only this installation runtime resources while preserving persistent user data.
Both packages provide stop and verify; stop cancels tasks, stops hosted daemons/owned helpers and removes sensitive active-page content.
Source packages expose release with existing version/tag/notes and trusted delivery workflow; source app upgrade is disabled; Release A/B remains supported.
All standard Windows interfaces execute the native C++ host and ship generated EXEs, with no PowerShell fallback.
Run focused lifecycle, real browser privacy, portable native and cross-compilation checks; keep native Windows acceptance distinct.
scope: scripts/aide.sh, maintenance, build, diagnostics, packaging and focused tests
Application shutdown privacy signal and runtime package capability
Current launcher/installation/update documentation and task evidence

requirements.summary: Issue #640 author proposal is the requested product contract; authenticated operator skyelan1999. Source/Release differences, command scope and acceptance are recorded.

design.summary: Explicit source build uses installation-scoped buildx cache and source image; start only reopens/starts existing runtime. Windows compiles current native host inside Docker and selects an immutable checksum-verified executable. Stop prioritizes a terminal SSE privacy event, cancels work and stops hosted daemons before joining callers. Source package identity overrides Release-image A/B capability.

implementation.summary: Implemented explicit source/Release command contracts, scoped build/cleanup, native Windows bootstrap/rebuild, source upgrade capability boundary and graceful stop privacy signal. Build applies the new verified image rather than reopening an old healthy image.

verification.summary: Focused tests passed; final current-main integration and remote required checks pending. Real browser blocked by Work settings; real Windows Docker Desktop not available.
evidence: 20 focused Go race tests and server vet pass in aide:ci-fulltest, no-network disposable source snapshot
35 production native core checks and 38 portable checks pass
Windows AMD64 and ARM64 cross-compilation and system-only PE imports pass; not Win32 execution
311 quick checks pass on original baseline before synchronizing newer main
Browser NOT_RUN: Local browser use is disabled in Work settings

documentation.summary: Updated current installation, maintenance, source update and Windows build guidance; canonical command matrix describes package identity, scoped resource ownership, privacy limits and existing release gates.

rollback: Not deployed. Revert the integration commit to restore former launcher behavior; preserve .env, .aide-data, offline archives and ownership receipts. Source build selects only an installation-scoped image after validation.
handoff: Feature branch targeting main. No tag, public Release or production deployment. Issue stays open pending real Windows Docker Desktop and browser privacy acceptance.
